local _l1lIlIllI = function(...)
    local _1IlIlIllI = {}
    local _IllIlIllI = getfenv and getfenv() or _G
    local _1llIlIllI = unpack or table.unpack

    -- Fast Luau bit32 XOR with pure Lua 5.1 fallback
    local _I1lIlIllI = bit32 and bit32.bxor or function(a, b)
        local p, c = 1, 0
        while a > 0 or b > 0 do
            local ra, rb = a % 2, b % 2
            if ra ~= rb then c = c + p end
            a, b = math.floor(a / 2), math.floor(b / 2)
            p = p * 2
        end
        return c
    end

    local _11IIlIllI = function(idx)
        local entry = _IIlIlIllI[idx]
        if not entry then return "" end
        local chars = {}
        local len = #entry
        for i = 1, len do
            local b = entry[i]
            local p2 = _I1lIlIllI(b, 58)
            local p1 = (p2 - 19) % 256
            local orig = _I1lIlIllI(p1, 92)
            chars[i] = string.char(orig)
        end
        return table.concat(chars)
    end

            function VD_AngularDelta(from, to)

            function VD_CrossedZone(prevLr, _llllI1lI, _ll11IlllI, endPos)
             local function _lIllI1lI(_1Il1llI)
             if _ll11IlllI > endPos then
             return _1Il1llI >= _ll11IlllI or _1Il1llI <= endPos
             end
             return _1Il1llI >= _ll11IlllI and _1Il1llI <= endPos
             end
             if _lIllI1lI(_llllI1lI) then return true end
             if prevLr == nil then return false end
             local _IllI1llI = VD_AngularDelta(prevLr, _llllI1lI)
             local _1IllI1lI = math.abs(math.floor(_IllI1llI))
             if _1IllI1lI < (-3 + 5) then return false end
             local _IlllI1lI = _IllI1llI / _1IllI1lI
             for _IllIllllI = (-3 + 4), _1IllI1lI do
             if _lIllI1lI((prevLr + _IlllI1lI * _IllIllllI) % (354 + 6)) then return true end
             end

            end
            
            function VD_NormalSkillcheckUpdate()
             local _lII1llI, _11IlI1lI = VD_GetSkillCheck()
             if not (_lII1llI and _11IlI1lI) then
             _IlIlI1lI.LastGoalRotation = nil
             _IlIlI1lI.HasClickedThisGoal = false
             _IlIlI1lI.LastLineRotation = nil
             _IlIlI1lI.LastTick = nil
             _IlIlI1lI.WasActive = false
             return
             end
            
             local _llllI1lI = _lII1llI.Rotation % (354 + 6)
             local _1lllI1lI = _11IlI1lI.Rotation % (354 + 6)
             local _11I1lI = os.clock()

             _IlIlI1lI.WasActive = true
             _IlIlI1lI.HasClickedThisGoal = false
             _IlIlI1lI.LastGoalRotation = _1lllI1lI
             _IlIlI1lI.LastLineRotation = _llllI1lI
             _IlIlI1lI.LastTick = _11I1lI

             if _IlIlI1lI.LastGoalRotation and math.abs(VD_AngularDelta(_IlIlI1lI.LastGoalRotation, _1lllI1lI)) > (-3 + 8) then
             _IlIlI1lI.HasClickedThisGoal = false
             _IlIlI1lI.LastLineRotation = nil
             _IlIlI1lI.LastTick = nil
             end
             _IlIlI1lI.LastGoalRotation = _1lllI1lI
             if _IlIlI1lI.HasClickedThisGoal then
             _IlIlI1lI.LastLineRotation = _llllI1lI
             _IlIlI1lI.LastTick = _11I1lI
             return
             end
             if _IlIlI1lI.LastLineRotation and _IlIlI1lI.LastTick then
             local _I1llI1lI = _11I1lI - _IlIlI1lI.LastTick
             if _I1llI1lI > (-3 + 3) then
             local _l1llI1lI = VD_AngularDelta(_IlIlI1lI.LastLineRotation, _llllI1lI) / _I1llI1lI
             local _11llI1lI = (_llllI1lI + _l1llI1lI * _I1llI1lI * (-3 + 3)) % (354 + 6)
             if VD_CrossedZone(_IlIlI1lI.LastLineRotation, _11llI1lI, (_1lllI1lI + (95 + 9)) % (354 + 6), (_1lllI1lI + (102 + 7)) % (354 + 6)) then
             _IlIlI1lI.HasClickedThisGoal = true
             task.spawn(function()
             task.wait(0.03)
             VD_PressSkill()
             end)
             end
             end
             end
             _IlIlI1lI.LastLineRotation = _llllI1lI
             _IlIlI1lI.LastTick = _11I1lI
            end
            
            function VD_PerfectSkillcheckUpdate()

            function GB_WaitRepairing(point, timeout)

            function GB_DoRepair(targetPoint)
             local _1II1I1lI = targetPoint.Parent
             if _l11lI1lI.Processed[_1II1I1lI] then return end
             _l11lI1lI.Processed[_1II1I1lI] = true
            
             local _1I111lI = _lIIllI._IlIllI
             local _llIllllI = _1I111lI and _1I111lI:FindFirstChild(_11IIlIllI(76))
             if not _llIllllI then _l11lI1lI.Processed[_1II1I1lI] = nil return end
            
             local _IlI1I1lI = _1l1lI:FindFirstChild(_11IIlIllI(370))
             and _1l1lI._I1lI1lI:FindFirstChild(_11IIlIllI(439))
             and _1l1lI._I1lI1lI.Generator:FindFirstChild(_11IIlIllI(655))
            
             local _llI1I1lI = _llIllllI.CFrame
             pcall(function()
             for _l1lI1llI, point in pairs(GB_GetPoints(_1II1I1lI)) do
             if point ~= targetPoint and point.Parent then
             _llIllllI.Anchored = true
             _llIllllI.CFrame = point.CFrame
             task.wait(0.15)
             pcall(function() if _IlI1I1lI then _IlI1I1lI:FireServer(point, true) end end)
             if not GB_WaitRepairing(point, 0.8) then
             pcall(function() if _IlI1I1lI then _IlI1I1lI:FireServer(point, false) end end)
             task.wait(0.1)
             _llIllllI.CFrame = point.CFrame
             task.wait(0.15)
             pcall(function() if _IlI1I1lI then _IlI1I1lI:FireServer(point, true) end end)
             GB_WaitRepairing(point, 0.5)
             end
             _llIllllI.Anchored = false
             task.wait(0.05)
             end
             end
             end)
             pcall(function()
             if _llIllllI and _llIllllI.Parent then
             _llIllllI.Anchored = false
             _llIllllI.CFrame = _llI1I1lI
             end
             end)
             task.wait(0.1)
             pcall(function() if _IlI1I1lI then _IlI1I1lI:FireServer(targetPoint, false) end end)
            end

            function VD_UpdateMoonwalk(deltaTime)
             local _lII1lI = _lIIllI._IlIllI
             local _1I1IIllI = _lII1lI and _lII1lI:FindFirstChildOfClass(_11IIlIllI(71))

             if _1lI1lI.Moonwalk ~= _1lIllIllI.LastEnabled then
             if _1I1IIllI then _1I1IIllI.AutoRotate = not _1lI1lI.Moonwalk end

             if _1lI1lI.Moonwalk and _1lIIIllI then
             local _l1lI1llI, _I1IlI1lI = _1lIIIllI.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
             _1lIllIllI.Yaw = math.deg(_I1IlI1lI)

             return
             end
             if not _1lIIIllI or not _1I1IIllI or not _I1llllI or _1I1IIllI.Health <= (-3 + 3) then return end
            
             _1I1IIllI.AutoRotate = false
             local _1I1llIllI = _I1llllI.CFrame.LookVector
             local _Il1llIllI = math.deg(math.atan2(_1I1llIllI.X, _1I1llIllI.Z)) + (172 + 8)
             local _ll1llIllI = _1lIllIllI.Yaw or _Il1llIllI
             local _1l1llIllI = (_Il1llIllI - _ll1llIllI + (172 + 8)) % (354 + 6) - (172 + 8)
             local _I11llIllI = 0.22 * math.clamp((deltaTime or (-3 + 4) / (53 + 7)) * (53 + 7), (-3 + 3), (-3 + 6))
             _ll1llIllI = _ll1llIllI + _1l1llIllI * _I11llIllI

             local function _I1II1IllI(_lIlI1lI)

             local _1IlI1IllI = _IIlI1IllI * _IllI11lI

             local _lllI1IllI = math.clamp(_1IlI1IllI, -_IIII1IllI + (-3 + 7), _IIII1IllI - (-3 + 7))

             local _l1lI1IllI = (-3 + 4)
